title: Lab 3B — Athena on Iceberg
topic: Athena serverless SQL on S3, Glue Data Catalog, Apache Iceberg table format, partitioning and scan cost, Athena vs Aurora OLTP vs Redshift, workgroups, Night 20 migration bucket reuse
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-24-athena-iceberg.md and night-24-lab-athena-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-24-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: GSA leadership wants ad hoc SQL: resort counts grouped by country_code on Parquet files exported to the Night 20 migration bucket. No always-on warehouse cluster. Best fit?

options.A: Amazon Athena with Glue catalog tables over the S3 Parquet/Iceberg paths
options.B: Amazon Aurora Serverless v2 — run GROUP BY on the live writer endpoint for this workload
options.C: ElastiCache Redis — store pre-aggregated country counts as JSON blobs
options.D: AWS DMS CDC — replicate S3 Parquet rows back into DynamoDB for GetItem

questions.question: Night 17 stats-uploader must UPSERT monthly_runs on resort_stats with millisecond latency and ACID guarantees. Which store is purpose-built?

options.B: Aurora PostgreSQL writer endpoint in private subnets — OLTP relational store
options.A: Athena INSERT INTO over Iceberg — primary transactional path for ski uploads
options.C: S3 Standard with object lock — one object per resort row updated via PUT
options.D: Athena CTAS nightly — replaces Aurora for all live write traffic for this workload

questions.question: An Athena query fails with “Table not found” though Parquet files exist in S3. What does the Glue Data Catalog provide that raw S3 lacks?

options.C: Registered table metadata — column names, format, and S3 location for SQL
options.A: Automatic ACID transactions so INSERT competes with Lambda writers for this workload
options.B: Internet-facing HTTPS endpoint so browsers query Parquet directly for this workload
options.D: Replacement for IAM — Glue stores user passwords for Athena login for this workload

questions.question: GSA prod registers Apache Iceberg tables on pipeline output instead of a loose Parquet folder. Which Iceberg capability matters most for “query yesterday’s snapshot after a bad ETL run”?

options.D: Iceberg snapshots / time travel — query an earlier table version without
options.A: Iceberg replaces the need for any S3 bucket — data lives in Athena RAM
options.B: Iceberg forces DynamoDB streams to push every viewCount change into SQL for this workload
options.C: Iceberg converts Aurora WAL into binlog for DMS heterogeneous moves

questions.question: Your Athena bill spikes after analysts scan an unpartitioned 8 TB export. Primary billing driver to optimize first?

options.A: Data scanned per query — add partition columns and filter predicates
options.B: Number of Glue crawlers scheduled per hour — disable all crawlers for this workload
options.C: Aurora ACU hours — Athena queries always spin up an Aurora reader
options.D: CloudFront edge requests — Athena SQL runs at every POP globally

questions.question: night-24-lab creates workgroup saa-study-gsa-athena with EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration. Queries fail until OutputLocation is set. Where do result CSV files land?

options.A: ElastiCache Redis — Athena streams result rows into cache keys
options.B: S3 prefix night-24/athena-results/ in the migration bucket workgroup config
options.C: DynamoDB saa-study-gsa-wiki-views — each row becomes a query item
options.D: Lambda /tmp only — S3 is never used for Athena query result outputs for this workload

questions.question: Night 20 exported saa-study-gsa-wiki-views to night-20/dynamodb/wiki-views/ as DynamoDB JSON. Why is that path not tonight’s direct SQL target for resort_stats analytics?

options.C: Format mismatch — wiki export is DynamoDB JSON, not relational
options.A: DynamoDB JSON exports are encrypted with KMS keys Athena cannot read
options.B: Athena only queries Aurora snapshots already loaded into the writer
options.D: Glue crawlers refuse to run on buckets tagged saa-study-migration=night-20

questions.question: 200 BI users run concurrent complex JOINs on a 50 TB curated star schema all day. Ad hoc serverless SQL on raw S3 alone is too slow. Better primary warehouse?

options.D: Amazon Redshift or Redshift Serverless — provisioned/ serverless MPP warehouse
options.A: Amazon Athena — pay per query with no cluster tuning ever needed for this workload
options.B: ElastiCache Memcached — store every JOIN result as a string key for this workload
options.C: CloudFront — cache warehouse SQL responses at the edge for this workload

questions.question: night-24-lab registers resort_snapshot with explicit Athena DDL and CTAS — no crawler deployed. Exam-accurate statement about Glue crawlers?

options.A: Crawlers are optional — manual DDL or CTAS can populate the catalog without
options.B: Every Athena query requires an hourly crawler run before SQL is allowed
options.C: Crawlers replace IAM roles for S3 read permissions on query results for this workload
options.D: Crawlers only work on Aurora — S3 tables must use DMS instead for this workload

questions.question: night-24-lab runs CREATE TABLE … table_type=ICEBERG via CTAS. DDL fails on Athena engine version 2 with unsupported table type. Fix?

options.B: Select Athena engine version 3 on the workgroup — Iceberg DDL needs v3
options.A: Move Redis to public subnets so Athena can reach Iceberg metadata
options.C: Enable PITR on the Glue database — Iceberg requires continuous backup
options.D: Switch to Memcached — Iceberg tables must be loaded into ElastiCache first

questions.question: You run night-24-lab-athena-teardown.ps1 after finishing analytics practice. What remains in AWS?

options.C: Night 20 night-20/ DynamoDB export prefix and bucket — only night-24/ Athena
options.A: Nothing — teardown deletes the entire migration bucket including Night 20 DynamoDB
options.B: Aurora cluster and Redis — teardown always deletes all Week 3 databases
options.D: Glue catalog for every GSA prod Iceberg table in the production account

questions.question: A 5-year resort export grows to terabytes. Queries filter on country_code every time. Best cost/latency habit?

options.D: Partition by country_code (or use Iceberg hidden partitioning) so Athena
options.A: Store all countries in one giant CSV object — Athena loves single files
options.B: Query Aurora reader instead — readers automatically partition S3 for free
options.C: Disable workgroup OutputLocation to avoid writing result files for this workload

questions.question: Nightly Spark job transforms 500 GB of raw JSON logs into curated Parquet before analysts run SQL. Which service runs the heavy batch transform?

options.A: AWS Glue ETL or Amazon EMR (Spark) — batch transform; Athena queries the output
options.B: Amazon Athena — primary engine for long-running Spark shuffle jobs for this workload
options.C: AWS Backup — backup plans convert JSON to Parquet during vault copy
options.D: Route 53 latency routing — routes log bytes to the cheapest S3 AZ for this workload

questions.question: Match workload to store: (1) live resort_stats UPSERT from SQS, (2) quarterly country rollup on historical S3 snapshots.

options.B: (1) Aurora OLTP writer, (2) Athena SQL on Glue/Iceberg over S3 exports
options.A: Both on Athena Iceberg — single store simplifies architecture for this workload
options.C: Both on DynamoDB streams — relational UPSERT and GROUP BY in one table
options.D: (1) CloudFront cache, (2) ElastiCache Redis TTL keys only for this workload

questions.question: Wiki viewCount hot reads (Night 18) need microsecond DynamoDB acceleration. Resort country analytics run on S3 snapshots (Tonight). Pick the DynamoDB-specific cache vs analytics SQL tool.

options.C: DAX for DynamoDB hot reads; Athena for SQL analytics on S3 — different layers
options.A: Use Athena workgroups to cache GetItem responses for wiki pageId keys for this workload
options.B: Redshift Spectrum replaces both DAX and DynamoDB for all GSA reads for this workload
options.D: ElastiCache Redis replaces Glue catalog registration for Iceberg tables for this workload
